name: Machine Learning and Optimization
description: Convex sets and functions, gradient descent, stochastic gradient descent, and variants; constrained optimization (Lagrange multipliers, KKT conditions); duality; applications in training machine learning models; bias-variance tradeoff; empirical risk minimization; VC dimension and generalization bounds; structural risk minimization; regularization and its role in controlling model complexity; PAC learning framework; kernel methods and reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS); Markov chains and Monte Carlo methods; introduction to deep learning theory; current trends.
